title: Retail Installment Contracts Training Q&A: Recent-Return Review on a Payoff
content:
*What is the recent-return review on a Retail Installment Contracts payoff?*

Review days set by how recently the contract's latest return was dated — the return with the latest return date, and among returns of the same date the one recorded first — counted in days before the posting date:

- When the latest return is dated no more than **4** days before the posting date, the review runs to the end of that window: it adds 4 less the days since the return.
- When it is dated more than 4 but no more than **30** days before, **1** review day is added.
- Otherwise none are added, and none are added when the contract has no return.

| Days from the latest return to the posting date | Review days added |
|---|---|
| 0 (returned on the posting date) | 4 |
| 1 | 3 |
| 3 | 1 |
| 4 | 0 |
| 5 | 1 |
| 30 | 1 |
| 31 or more | none |

*Why does a return 4 days before add nothing, while one 5 days before adds a day?* At 4 days the window has run to its end (4 less 4 is zero); from 5 to 30 days the flat single day applies.
